recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-paneled grid composition simulating a wall of surveillance monitors, featuring a central figure spanning multiple screens, rendered in a high-contrast cyanotype-blue palette with visible horizontal scanlines and a black structural frame.
coreVisualRelationships: A central subject split across a 4x4 grid of rounded-corner rectangles.
Foreground silhouettes of operators at workstations looking up at the grid.
High-contrast blue-and-black color scheme emphasizing digital surveillance.
Large, italicized display typography centered over the middle horizontal axis.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue tint across all photographic elements.
Heavy black grid lines separating the 'monitor' screens.
Horizontal CRT scanline texture applied to all imagery.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered, occupying the middle four to six grid panels at a medium-close scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, high-contrast title text positioned horizontally across the center of the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move outward to the surrounding monitor panels, and drop to the silhouettes at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Black grid lines provide structural negative space, creating a sense of confinement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Electric Blue (Mid-tones and highlights of the imagery).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Grid lines, shadows, and silhouettes).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with limited hue range; saturation is concentrated in the cyan-blue spectrum.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain strict monochromatic blue-scale for images.

letterConstructionRules: Strong rightward slant (italics) to suggest speed or urgency.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Gradient fill from white to light blue.
Thin red or dark blue outer stroke.
Hard drop shadow to separate text from the busy background.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small-caps sans-serif for metadata at the bottom, spaced widely.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and aggressive stance.
Captures the tech/surveillance aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 4x4 grid of rounded-corner monitors separated by thick black borders. The central monitors show a man in distress, while outer monitors show blurry security footage. Apply a monochromatic blue tint and horizontal scanlines across all screens. Add silhouettes of people at computer desks at the very bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, bold, italicized sans-serif text in the center with a white-to-blue gradient fill and a hard black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly blue and black?
Are the scanlines visible across the imagery?
Is the grid structure clearly defined by black lines?
Is the text centered and highly legible against the background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any specific logos or advisory stickers
Exact wording of the metadata text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text has a hard drop shadow for depth.
Check that the scanlines do not obscure the subject's expression.
Verify the bottom silhouettes are dark enough to be distinct from the monitors.
Confirm the grid corners are consistently rounded.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surveillance Grid + Monochromatic Blue Tint + Scanline Texture + Bold Italic Display Type.
